Name: Maggs Lilypad Frogs
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
Add frogs to the lilypads in the lakes and rivers. Choose from random colors, or green and blue. Tadpoles in spring, small frogs in summer, and large frogs in fall. None in winter, they are hibernating ;)

Works with re-color mods, shown with DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1768199442.png[/img]
Colors
[b]Random[/b]: green, teal, blue, red, orange, yellow, white (colors are randomly chosen daily, frog position is also random: facing front, left or right)
[b]Green and blue[/b]: green, teal, blue

Invasion size
Choose to only have frogs appear on the plain lily pads.

Added a "no frog" chance in the rotation, so if they disappear for a day, you hit the "frogs are hiding" random chance :D
